source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original OAuth helper waited before dispatching shutdown wake-up registration. If Connect never called its listener, that later registration could not release the same wait. This landing registers the AppShutdownConfirmed wake-up in the main-thread runnable before Connect and also handles entry after that shutdown phase by clearing the token and notifying. Its test deliberately leaves the mock connection unresolved, advances the phase and checks NS_ERROR_FAILURE from the pending IMAP URL. Accepted source later adds completion predicates and a first-outcome-wins helper; those later guards are separate from this initial ordering fix. No native shutdown, OAuth flow or test ran here.
title: Register the OAuth shutdown wake-up before starting an unresolved connection
